_doc: Tile kinds of the town grid (GDD 05 §5.4, D3). walk_cost: path cost of entering the tile (null = blocked). color: greybox colour until the art arrives. The 1-char codes are what data/maps/*.json rows use. H3: stall (market stall) and board (contract board) are blocked tiles served from the tile the map declares as their service tile. Town builder (tools/city/, docs/protocolos/generar-ciudad.md): dock = a pier over the water (walkable), ford = a shallow crossing of a stream (walkable, slow), wall = town or precinct wall, rock = the sierra, landmark = the footprint of a cosmetic landmark (cathedral, warehouse, mine...: data/maps "landmarks", drawn by the view, never read by the sim).
